evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone search capability; no other backlog story is a prerequisite at the requirement level.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Requires existence of a user profile to base search on; that prerequisite is not self-contained in this story and is only addressed by other profile-based stories.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having user profiles/behavior data to compute similarity between users; not self-contained.

evaluations.evidence: similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Defines a content-similarity search given an input video; does not require another specific story to exist first.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Can be delivered as a search feature assuming metadata/tags exist in the system; no explicit dependency on another backlog story is inherent.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained ingestion requirement; other stories may use the tags but this story does not inherently depend on them.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Requires videos to be segmented into segments before thumbnail sequences of segments can be shown; segmentation is covered elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Depends on having similarity relationships computed/available; that capability is explicitly requested in other similarity stories.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Inherently requires a perceptual similarity computation/index to exist; not self-contained and overlaps with the prerequisite similarity capability.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Requires user profiles and a notion of profile similarity; those prerequisites are requested in other profile/similarity stories.

evaluations.evidence: recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone recommendation feature using location and news-event relevance; no explicit dependency on another story is inherent.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained feature: person identification plus retrieval of related info; no other story is a prerequisite at the requirement level.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained identification-and-info feature; no inherent dependency on another backlog story.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained recognition feature; does not require another story to be implemented first.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained recognition feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Defines an input (image) and an output (recommended videos); no inherent dependency on another specific story.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Standalone map-based discovery feature; does not inherently require another backlog story.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained search modality; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as an admin workflow for segmentation (manual or auto-assisted) without requiring another story as a prerequisite.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Requires that 'news video segments' exist (i.e., segmentation has been produced) before segment-level annotation/topic extraction can occur.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Standalone admin capability to filter/rank by quality; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained analysis feature; does not inherently depend on another backlog story.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Standalone moderation/filtering feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained prefilter/search requirement; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Standalone validation feature applied to ingested content; does not inherently require another story to be implemented first.

evaluations.evidence: search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system of provided by the user
evaluations.rationale: Defines a prefilter/search capability; while it uses metadata/tags, no specific other story is an inherent prerequisite in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having citizen annotations and Talk comments available; prompting/assessment cannot be done without those upstream capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Requires annotations and Talk comments to exist before detection/prompting can be performed; not self-contained.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone classification/segmentation of volunteers; no explicit prerequisite story is stated.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Standalone preclassification feature for a dataset; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained detection feature; no prerequisite story required.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection ... timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection feature for a specific case; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained preclassification feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Standalone preclassification feature; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained detection feature; no prerequisite story required.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Standalone segmentation/localization feature; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained detection feature; no prerequisite story required.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Standalone analysis feature; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained preclassification feature; no prerequisite story required.

evaluations.evidence: automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Standalone analysis/compression feature; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time ... where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained detection feature; does not inherently require another story to be implemented first.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features ... in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone scoring model using experience data; no explicit dependency on another story is inherent.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained image-cleaning/prefiltering feature; no prerequisite story required.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection feature; no inherent dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained audio processing feature; no prerequisite story required.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Standalone clustering/grouping feature; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained counting/detection feature; no prerequisite story required.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having an interruption mechanism and content/channel decisioning, which are specified in related interruption stories.

evaluations.evidence: interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Depends on the higher-level capability/decision of when to interrupt; choosing modality presupposes an interruption trigger decision.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having an education delivery mechanism and modality/content selection, which are covered by related education stories.

evaluations.evidence: educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Depends on the decision of when to educate; modality choice presupposes an education trigger decision.

evaluations.evidence: which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Depends on having an education intervention context (i.e., that the system has decided to educate and can deliver education), which is specified in related stories.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained detection/notification requirement about comments; does not inherently require another story to exist first.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Depends on having the capability to generate/select what Zoonibot should say; that content decision is specified separately.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Depends on having the capability to determine the explanation content (what to say), which is specified in another story.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on the context of when Zoonibot should comment or explain; content selection presupposes a trigger/use-case for speaking.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Standalone grouping/clustering feature; no explicit prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Depends on having volunteer experience/history data and/or volunteer typing to base recommendations on; those prerequisites are addressed in another story.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained admin feature to view summaries; no inherent dependency on another story.
